title: Website editor dedicates the central rail to a borderless full-width canvas

source.ref: Owner website editor canvas and controls request, 2026-10-15

detail: The Frequency website editor spent 56 horizontal pixels and 132 vertical pixels on an outer artboard around a rounded 1180 px-capped website frame. The handwritten editor skin now lets the desktop website fill the central rail with no surrounding card, border, shadow, rounding or gutters. Rails reduce from 280/320 px to 240/280 px, with a 52 px desktop fine-pointer toolbar and tighter inspector spacing. Tablet 820 px and phone 390 px viewport caps, section selection outlines, zoom, folding, draft/save/publish and document handlers remain intact; DAWN and generated design-system exports are untouched. Zoom and Vera share the bottom edge without overlapping the site header; narrow canvases stack utilities. Fine-pointer density does not shrink touch controls or inspector fields. No data or theme settings are changed. Inspector labels keep their character count alongside the field name and place helper text on a separate full-width line; the input keeps an 8px gap so compression does not crowd guidance.

verify.evidence: Production WebsiteEditorShell rendered with public Group content in a read-only SSR visual fixture. At 1280 x 720, measured columns 240 / 760 / 280px and frame/scroller/stage identical 760 x 668px at (240, 52); no horizontal overflow. Visually inspected desktop and 390px mobile toolbar. Existing 44 tests across five shell, canvas and inspector suites pass; scoped ESLint, token guard and git diff checks pass. This fixture does not claim authenticated editing or production deployment acceptance.
